query: Should I use a financial advisor or just manage my investments myself? I have about $150k in savings.
atoms: perspective: Investor prone to emotional decision-making
perspective: High-complexity situation (business owner, estate planning)
trustworthiness: Investment platform (potential conflict of interest)
plausible_answers: Answer A (DIY Default): Self-manage with a simple three-fund index portfolio — at $150k with a straightforward situation, the 0.5–1% advisor fee compounds into tens of thousands of dollars of unnecessary cost over time.

Answer B (Fee-Only Advisor for Complexity): Hire a fee-only fiduciary advisor if your situation involves business ownership, equity compensation, estate planning, or you've historically made emotional investing decisions during market downturns.

Answer C (Robo-Advisor Middle Ground): Use a robo-advisor at 0.25% AUM for automated rebalancing and tax-loss harvesting — you get most of the value of active management at a fraction of the cost of a human advisor.
